nodes.title: Motor-mount slip clamp: the D-23 fuse
nodes.equation: side force at the can that turns the collar F = T / (x_tube - x_can_mid); root moment = F z_m (brace ignored: conservative); hold ratio = T / (M_mount,ult ff pf); bolt clamp N = T / (mu pi r)

nodes.title: Prop plane to the nearest structure behind it
nodes.equation: hub on the canted axis: x_prop = x_face - stack cos(cant) (D-51); gap = collar front - prop plane = face_ahead + stack cos(cant); required 0.14 D (B4 CR-B4-04). Tip over the tube (disc mid-plane, blade tip straight toward the wing, -z): x_tip = x_prop - sense tan(cant) (y_m / r_m) D/2; tip gap = (x_t - od/2) - x_tip (B4 CL-B4-GAP-TUBE does the same on its geometry)

nodes.title: Motor screw thread engagement on the 7 deg canted plate
nodes.equation: R3 canted plate (front and back faces both on the cant plane): engagement = L_screw - t_plate at every hole; for comparison the R2 flat plate + canted pads would give L - (t + tan(cant) max|t.hole|)

nodes.title: Station collar height, tongue fit and two-face tail length
nodes.equation: R4 (D-48): collar ratio = h / h_req (C4-R3 envelope torsion + brace shear) and h / h_req_c6 (C6, max of C1 and C4 torsion + brace shear); tongue fit = h - (w / cos e + tongue depth), e = top-edge slope from the collar top (L/2 - grip - gap) at the LE (x_t + od/2 + gap) to the half height at the step front (te - sq); strip embedment = tail - LE gap, ratio = embedment / embed_req (C6, two faces bonded: tongue + wall)

nodes.title: Strap eye on the block boss (H1 restrained run)
nodes.equation: worst ligament e = min(L - yh - d/2, (h - d)/2); shear-out capacity 2 e t tau; RF = capacity / (F sf pf)

nodes.title: Stepped foot tip for D5's shoe
nodes.equation: R4 (D-54): square-tip ratio = D3 tip length / D5 step length (te - x_step D5); step mismatch = max(|x_sq - x_d5|, |z_step - z_d5|); tip edge width = n t_board

nodes.title: ESC pad inside the hover slipstream
nodes.equation: pad radial extent from the motor axis r = |z_m - z_pad| -/+ h/2 inside [hub R, wash R]

nodes.title: Half-fin root fillet joint, foot side load
nodes.equation: R5 (D-65): M = share S_side,ult pf h with the design foot side load (C1 max of friction and C5's 3-D sim, ultimate; was mu F_foot). R4 fillet zones (fins.py): full leg over the last L_eff of BONDED root from the TE, leg_aft aft of the hinge x_h = c (1 - ef), the lower root skips the link slot x_h +/- slot (CR-D6-04). M_cap = sigma_xps sum(leg_i (t_fin + leg_i) L_i); governing = the root whose full zone carries the least; rf_allow = rf kd (C6 allowable, CR-C6-24)

nodes.title: Brace geometry, D3 R3
nodes.equation: ear point (x_t, y_f - r_collar - ear/2, z_ear_mid = L_tube/2 - grip - gap - ear_h/2), anchor (x_s, y_a, z_skin + proud/2); Pcr = pi^2 E (w t^3/12) / L^2 (pinned, thin axis); Pcr ratio = Pcr / F_design (C4); lateral axial stiffness ky = E w t (dy/L)^2 / L (information). R3: no longer reads C4's R1 strut (CR-C4-26)

nodes.title: Fins subsystem flying mass, design R5
nodes.how: T-D3-WEIGH; sum of subsystems/fins/interfaces.json
nodes.note: from make_fins.py (CAD volumes x densities). R4 against the D-48 418 g: collar 16 -> 12 mm -2.0 g (not -3: the 12 mm ear already spanned the ring top), ESC pads 31 mm +0.8 g, and the 15 mm root fillets now CAD bodies at 0.55 g/cm3 (CL-D3-FILLET-MASS) in place of the 3 g/root estimate: +20 g where D-48 booked +3 g. R4b (CR-A3-26): forward sealing bead 6 -> 4 mm -1.6 g. The laminate itself did not grow (CL-D3-LAMINATE-MASS); the rest of the overrun is the C6 root fillet (D-63: 437 g). R5 (CR-A1-63): cheeks +5 mm and the 7.5 mm face_ahead (mounts 47.8 g), pins 2.5 mm, collar 15 mm (C6-R5 needs 13.007 mm), block edges R 3 mm -0.4 g: 440.3 g; lever taken: fillet mix 0.55 -> 0.45 g/cm3 -5.6 g (T-D3-WEIGH cup <= 9.0 g). Block fill (C4) and cheeks (withdrawn: length set by the reach to the collar) not taken
